project.description: Upstox order adapter (live adapters plan step B2, 8 Nov 2026): v3 place / modify / cancel with our tag, the order, trade and position books, funds, Upstox's instrument file; and a local Upstox simulator with fault injection for DRY_RUN and tests. DRY_RUN only in this build: no LIVE connection exists. A module of its own, apart from broker-upstox (market data, zt-tiger-v2's token, the Upstox SDK): order code never shares a class path with zt's token reader, and the execution worker does not pull in the SDK or the market-data stack. No SDK: plain HTTP (java.net.http) and Jackson.
